a segment-based proxy caching scheme can achieve the highest bandwidth saving for streaming media in the backbone network and the lowest startup latency for users.
the proposed popularity-wise caching algorithm is the best choice to deal with arbitrary user interactivity and arbitrary popularity distribution of streaming media content.

the design of an efficient caching algorithm for highly interactive streaming video media.
the problem of proxy caching for interactive video media and provides a solution that is more suitable for interactive scenarios than current segment-based proxy caching algorithms.

the popularity of streaming content should be taken into account when designing caching algorithms for interactive streaming.
